cd . && python3 - <<'PY'
import csv
auth={r['案号']:r for r in csv.DictReader(open('out/授权.csv',encoding='utf-8-sig'))}
lock={'J01':3,'J02':0,'J03':1,'J04':0,'J05':3,'J06':1,'J07':2,'J08':1,'J09':0,'J10':1,'J11':2,'J12':0}
act={'J01':4,'J02':1,'J03':3,'J04':1,'J05':4,'J06':2,'J07':3,'J08':2,'J09':3,'J10':1,'J11':4,'J12':2}
st={'J01':'东港','J02':'东港','J03':'东港','J04':'西湾','J05':'西湾','J06':'西湾',
    'J07':'南站','J08':'南站','J09':'南站','J10':'北仓','J11':'北仓','J12':'北仓'}
cap={'东港':8,'西湾':7,'南站':8,'北仓':7}
pool={s:cap[s]-sum(lock[c] for c in lock if st[c]==s) for s in cap}
cases=sorted(auth,key=lambda c:(int(auth[c]['优先号']),c))
tgt={};rem=dict(pool)
for c in cases:
    add=min(max(0,int(auth[c]['额度'])-lock[c]),rem[st[c]]); rem[st[c]]-=add; tgt[c]=lock[c]+add
rows=[]
for c in sorted(tgt):
    rows.append([c,auth[c]['批文'],int(auth[c]['额度']),0,int(auth[c]['额度']),int(auth[c]['优先号']),tgt[c],act[c],'期初'])
with open('out/调度.csv','w',encoding='utf-8',newline='') as f:
    w=csv.writer(f,lineterminator='\n')
    w.writerow(['案号','批文','基础额度','兑入','额度','优先号','目标','实占','最后受理号']); w.writerows(rows)
print(open('out/调度.csv',encoding='utf-8').read())
# 第一批：先减后增
red=[c for c in sorted(tgt) if tgt[c]-act[c]<0]
inc=[c for c in sorted(tgt) if tgt[c]-act[c]>0]
order=red+inc
req=[]
for i,c in enumerate(order,1):
    req.append([c,f'D3A{i:02d}',1,tgt[c]])
with open('out/站务申请-0603a.csv','w',encoding='utf-8',newline='') as f:
    w=csv.writer(f,lineterminator='\n'); w.writerow(['案号','请求号','预期版本','目标席']); w.writerows(req)
print('减:',red); print('增:',inc); print(open('out/站务申请-0603a.csv',encoding='utf-8').read())
PY
